symptoms: Sudden onset severe loin-to-groin flank pain, haematuria, nausea, vomiting

management_steps.details: IV Rehydration. Diclofenac 75mg IM/IV STAT. Fentanyl 1 ug/kg IV or Morphine 0.1mg/kg IV. Metoclopramide 10mg IV.
Paracetamol 1g PO QID. Diclofenac 25-50mg PO TDS. Tramadol 50-100mg PO TDS x 5 days.
